backtest_cases.request_description: Printex stationery invoice 3% over PO for freight; GRN done.
CoolAir repaired a pantry AC; ₹80,000 invoice, no PO raised; GRN done.
NetSure CCTV upgrade invoiced at ₹2.4 lakh without a PO.
Metro Cabs invoice is 14% over the PO due to night-shift surcharges.
Sparkle invoice 2% over PO; facilities has not confirmed the GRN yet.
Client dinner ₹9,000, slightly over per-diem; receipt attached.
Taxi and meals claim ₹11,000; receipts lost.
IT network-switch spend will run 18% over the cost-centre budget.
Sales manager submitting his own ₹8,000 expense claim for his own approval.
GreenLeaf (MSME) catering invoice 2.5% over PO; accepted 38 days ago.
Soundwave AV invoice ₹96,000, no PO, for the 4th-floor conference room upgrade (Phase 2). Under the ₹1 lakh no-PO limit.
backtest_cases.why: Second invoice for the same AV upgrade (Phase 1 ₹94,500 last month): aggregated ₹1.9 L (FL01).

backtest_cases.request_description: Sparkle cleaning invoice 3.1% over PO; GRN done. The invoice says their bank account has changed and gives the new details.
backtest_cases.why: Invoice carries new bank details: callback first (FL02).

backtest_cases.request_description: Facilities wants ergonomic chairs now, 7% over budget, 'so the remaining budget doesn't lapse at year-end'; funding from the pantry line.
backtest_cases.why: March-style 'before it lapses' purchase: needs a use plan (FL03).

backtest_cases.request_description: Metro Cabs asks for a 20% advance for the festive fleet. They mention their drivers' salaries were delayed last month.
backtest_cases.why: 20% advance, but supplier says drivers' salaries are delayed (FL04).

backtest_cases.request_description: URGENT: server-room AC failed overnight; CoolAir fixed it by 6 am. ₹42,000, no PO, rate card matches, GRN done.
backtest_cases.why: URGENT server-room AC failure fixed overnight; rate card matches.
